evidence: Modifies netbase connection helpers and their callers across P2P networking and Tor/I2P integrations (src/netbase.cpp, src/net.cpp, src/torcontrol.cpp, src/i2p.cpp).
rationale: Refactors connection failure handling so socket errors are returned to callers rather than logged internally via the `manual_connection` boolean. This is an internal logging and error-propagation cleanup with no functional impact on network protocol or relay behavior.
